A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we
start building.

What kinds of projects are a good fit?

Custom websites, digital products, AI assistants, and workflow automation. A focused discovery phase helps identify the right approach.

Can you work with an existing product?

Yes. An engagement can focus on improving an existing experience, connecting tools, adding AI features, or extending a platform.

How is a project scoped?

Start with the goal, the essential features, and your timeline. These become a practical scope with milestones and clear deliverables.

What should I prepare before reaching out?

A short description of your idea, who it is for, any reference examples, and a preferred timeline. Use the project brief builder below to put those details together.
